cases.name: Andrea Heiser
cases.about:
She was bestowed with an honorary degree. She was working towards a Bachelor of Science in statistics.

"Andrea’s dad, three sisters and her boyfriend accepted the degree on her behalf.

“The graduates walked in and of course as they’re walking by I’m thinking… where’s Andrea,” said Randy. “I always knew Andrea would graduate, I just never thought it would be like this.”

Wright State saw the hard work that Andrea put in, that’s why the university sent Randy a letter about the announcement that invited her family to receive the Bachelor of Science degree she was working towards.

“Read the first paragraph, tears started flowing,” he said. “She worked hard at everything she did, it didn’t matter what it was.”

A speech given at the graduation ceremony stated, “Known by her peers and faculty as a bright light. Andrea Heiser’s smile, maturity, and eagerness to learn and succeed were admired by many. Andrea was a planner and she was on the cusp of completing her undergraduate degree and more than ready to begin her master’s program. Her light and her love will stay with all who knew her.”

cases.name: Jennifer Sirons
cases.about: Jennifer was chief financial officer for the Clark County Juvenile Court since 2011. Judge Robert Vaughn and the county commissioners released statements Wednesday expressing condolences. “Jen was not only a very gifted and devoted employee here at the court, she was also a very sweet friend to many of us,” Judge Vaughn said.

cases.name: Rodline Anacreon
cases.about:
Her obituary said: "(She was born) in Carrefour, Haiti; raised in Leogane, and migrated to the United States in 2008. 

 She is a proud resident of Belle Glade, FL, and was a 2016 graduate of Glades Central Community High School. She proceeded to further her studies at Palm Beach State College while becoming a certified home health aid until she relocated to Vineland, New Jersey. 

 Rodline was very outgoing, selfless, a great cook, a mother of twin boys, and a growing social media personality. Her family and content creation were her two biggest passions; she loved posting videos on her YouTube channel with her best friend Esther and her other social media platforms. 

 Rodline had the ability to make everyone feel seen, heard, and loved. Rodline went above and beyond to help everyone in need of her services. Rodline was the type of woman to give her last unbeknownst to you that it was her last."
